name: Glucose
rangeNote: This range is for a fasting sample (no food for at least 8 hours).
summary: Glucose is the main sugar in your blood and the body's main fuel. Its level is tightly controlled by insulin and other hormones.

high.meaning: A high fasting glucose can be a sign of prediabetes or diabetes. A single high value after eating is expected.

low.meaning: Low glucose (hypoglycaemia) can cause shakiness, sweating and confusion. It is uncommon in people who do not take glucose-lowering medicines.
commonCauses: Delayed sample processing (glucose drops in the tube)
